Faster incomplete/failed cases are not promising quality-equivalent recipes. Freeze selected full recipe and common same-family/account/model/caps/access before holdout preparation. No exposed initial-case source selections/answers/critique/evaluator feedback accompany it. If no recipe qualifies, holdouts remain NOT_RUN; never spend them on a rescued known answer.
